I changed nothing in the game: the overlap is already gone, and the one duplicate left is the in-raid feed copy you ordered on 10-15. Nothing shipped, so there was no check to write.

- **Overlap on 34 (downed with pickups):** fresh pictures at 1080p and 4K show no two text boxes touching in the right column. I did not shoot a P2 window.
- **Warning on 33 (fight alerts):** it is drawn twice now, not three times. "the pillbox has seen you" is the red banner plus a row in the left feed, and "location revealed" and "running slowly" are likewise a top-centre row plus a left feed row. The cause is `say()`: every line shown also goes into the feed, which is your 10-15 order. Removing the copies would reverse that, so I kept both and logged the question in `questions.md`.
- **Critic (run on the old pictures):** 34 scored 2 and 33 scored 2.
  - **34:** the downed card is a flat box rather than the standard panel. The run info rows wrap. A long "contract done" sentence sits at the top.
  - **33:** the duplicate alerts, plus the controls cheat-sheet in the centre of the screen.
  - These are the next real work if a later run takes them. I did not touch them because they were outside the two named defects.

Notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/106-ui-raid-column-overlaps.md`, with pictures in `shots/106-before` and `shots/106-4k`.
